identificationModule.briefTitle: Utidelone Versus Docetaxel in HER2-negative Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Utidelone Versus Docetaxel in HER2-negative Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer : A Phase III, Open Label, Randomized Controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: It is a phase III trial to explore the efficacy and safety of utidelone versus docetaxel in HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

conditions: Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer

interventions.name: utidelone
interventions.description: Eligible patients will receive treatment with utidelone(40 mg/ m2 /day, D1-5,Q3W) , treated until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity or patient request for withdrawal, whichever occurs first. Each cycle is 3 weeks in duration.

interventions.name: docetaxel
interventions.description: Eligible patients will receive treatment with docetaxel (75mg/ m2/day, D1, Q3W) , treated until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity or patient request for withdrawal, whichever occurs first. Each cycle is 3 weeks in duration.

primaryOutcomes.description: Time from randomization to progression or death (whichever occurred first)

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients with a best response of CR or PR, according to RECIST 1.1 criteria
the time from randomization to the first documentation of disease response (CR or PR)
the time from the first evaluation that criteria for CR or PR are met until PD or death is observed, whichever occurs first, calculated only for patients whose best response is evaluated as CR or PR.
Time from randomization to death Time from randomization to death Time from randomization to death Time from randomization to death

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Patient-reported health-related quality of life (QoL): FACT-B total score
secondaryOutcomes.description: Change from baseline in the FACT-B total score for all questionnaire timepoints. To calculate FACT-B total score patient ratings from 0 (not at all) - 4 (very much) to each of the 37 questionnaire statement are summed up. Total score range: 0 - 148. Higher values indicate better quality of life.
